items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of doubled dental subsidy
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The one-month Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG runs from the date the decision counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe). For a statutory health insurer, delivery of a posted letter is on the 4th calendar day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), and this delivery day does not shift even if it falls on a weekend or holiday. However, this letter carries no printed document date and no stated posting date ('zur Post gegeben am'), so the posting day — and therefore the delivery day and the start of the one-month period — cannot be determined. No reliable due date can be computed from the available information.
